hero_title.en: The Standard for Canadian Media & Technology Insights

hero_description.en: Real data on how Canadians consume media, technology, and content - built for organizations that need evidence, not assumptions.

access_item_1_description.en: Track rapid shifts across streaming platforms, AI advancements, connected devices, and emerging technologies. Identify where consumer demand is heading next.

access_item_2_description.en: Understand attention, viewing habits, engagement, and platform usage across audiences and channels.

access_item_3_description.en: Explore one of Canada’s most comprehensive media and technology datasets. Connect demographics, behaviours, attitudes, and intent to uncover meaningful opportunities.

product_1_description.en: Comprehensive data on Canadians aged 18 and older, covering media consumption, technology adoption, and digital behaviours

product_2_description.en: Insights into the media and technology habits of Canadians aged 2–17

product_3_description.en: Research focused on Canadians who have arrived within the past five years, offering valuable insights into settlement, media usage, and technology adoption

product_4_description.en: Comprehensive demographic and population data for enhanced analysis and targeting.

package_2_description.en: Access a growing library of reports, infographics, and trend analyses covering media, technology, platforms, behaviours, and demographic groups across Canada — available in both official languages. Explore the latest findings or download a sample report to see the depth of MTM insights.

package_3_description.en: Build custom views, apply advanced filters, and explore trends dynamically with MTM’s suite of interactive data tools.

faq_3_question.en: Is MTM data accepted as a source for funding publication and policy submissions?

faq_3_answer.en: Yes. MTM data is widely used across the Canadian media, advertising, academic, and public sectors to support publications, strategic planning, funding applications, and policy development.

faq_4_question.en: How does MTM ensure the validity and reliability of its datasets?

faq_4_answer.en: MTM uses rigorous research methodologies, large-scale national sampling, and ongoing quality assurance processes to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and representativeness across all studies.
